JESUS GAVE US A PATTERN

THE MODEL PRAYER.

One prayer. Ten simple parts. Tap any line to see what Jesus teaches us, then explore the related teachings from Pray Like Christ.

MATTHEW 6:9–13NIV

This, then, is how you should pray:

Our Father in heaven,
hallowed be your name,
your kingdom come,
your will be done,
on earth as it is in heaven.

Give us today our daily bread.
And forgive us our debts,
as we also have forgiven our debtors.

And lead us not into temptation,
but deliver us from the evil one.

It's a pattern for approaching the Father, not a performance to memorize.

THE HEART BEHIND THE BOOK

THERE IS A WAY BACK.

We Are Yahweh's Born Again Children of the King.

Christ did not teach prayer simply so we could get better at asking for things. He showed us the way back to our Father.

Know Him. Make Him known. Keep coming back to the Father.
